title: Majesty Deep Sea Fishing
specs: Largest party boat in Northeast Florida at 65' long and 20' wide beam
Boat powered by twin 700 HP Lugger engines
Wildlife sightings include dolphins, whales, sharks, sea turtles, and sea birds
Arrive 30 minutes prior to departure (by 7:30 AM)
Children must be supervised by an adult
No more than 3 rods per person; 80 lb test recommended; no braided lines or trouble hooks
Those with knee, back, heart problems, pregnant women, or recent surgery should not come aboard
Allowed to bring one six-pack of beer in aluminum cans per person; no other alcohol
Private charters available for families, company outings, church groups, and other parties
Boat accommodates 46 outside, 25 inside, 14 on sun deck
